title: Vacation Supply Release — Member Services Tool Card
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — early refills for travel.** A vacation override granted for a prescription is owed one released vacation fill of that prescription. The drug is the one named on the latest vacation override granted on the coverage.

### Business effect

The release adds one paid fill of the overridden prescription to the member's pharmacy claims, dated the day it is released and marked as a vacation override fill, with the days supply and copay given. Afterwards the pharmacy can dispense the released days ahead of the ordinary refill date, and the member's pharmacy claims show the vacation fill.

### How it is invoked

This is an agent-side action. The agent unlocks the tool `release_vacation_supply_4890f9e9` and then calls it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rx_coverage_id` | The reference number of the member's pharmacy coverage record, as returned by the pharmacy coverage lookup for the verified member | Identifier, as shown by the lookup |
| `rx_exception_id` | The reference number of the granted vacation override entry, as returned by the pharmacy requests lookup for the coverage | Identifier, as shown by the lookup |
| `days_supply` | The days of the drug released | A positive integer number of days |
| `member_copay` | The copay assessed on the vacation fill | USD, signed, with 2 decimal places; 0.00 where the plan sets no copay |

### Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of `rx_fill_id` (the reference number of the vacation fill claim), `rx_number` (the prescription number), `drug_name`, `days_supply` (integer days), `member_copay` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `status` (the text "released", which confirms the vacation supply was recorded).

### Contract note

*Which prescription is released?* The prescription of the granted vacation override named in `rx_exception_id`.
